scope: WP09 frozen project contract; authenticated Python files are loaded from external authorized-LXC checkouts; no vendor copies in the repository

tent.origin: Official author repository linked by the Tent project
tent.used: Only softmax_entropy with original raw fused logits, stateless native SGD and an original probability-floor fallback
tent.excluded: BatchNorm tracking policy, full parameter collector and online wrapper do not match active DomainBN/region layers, pre-update durable prediction, or episode-level reset.

openood.origin: Official benchmark repository linked by the OpenOOD paper

license.applies: base_postprocessor.py, ebo_postprocessor.py, evaluators/metrics.py at the fixed OpenOOD revision

distributed_dependency.assessment: Nearby official Detectron2 revisions differ in bytes and the fixed OpenOOD path history does not establish the provenance or license chain of the exact file.
distributed_dependency.action: Removed from authentication and execution. An independently authored placeholder fails on every distributed API access. New evidence excludes the unresolved source.

openood.used: Deferred offline comparison on frozen raw network logits and original thresholds. OOD-positive ROC matches after score orientation and semantic filtering.
openood.excluded: No same-role squared-distance source mean prototype. Native scoring and known-only conservative calibration remain authoritative.
